title: PLE: introduce Private Line Emulation dissector
description:
The dissector implements dissection of all protocol fields and adds
expert items to those that are deemed invalid, based on the protocol
definition or from other content in the same packet. Inter-packet
correlation is not taken into account, nor settings based on signaling.
The type of sequence numbering is heuristically determined from the
packet contents, unless explicitly configured. Then more detailed
expert items regarding the sequence numbering are possible.
